title: Cross-family harness integration (howto): relay, induce, autonomy.toml
desc: T2 implementation tier. The relay structure, the exact induce commands, the gemini-cli policy schema (commandPrefix/commandRegex/argsPattern), the wkgemini self-limit, and the codex nudge-guide. Parent: cross-family-harness-integration. Ref: cross-family-harness-integration-ref.
steps: RELAY (D:/GitHub/wkharness.ps1) -- reads stdin JSON; if it is a tool call, maps the gemini/agy tool name to Claude format via two tables (agyMap: run_command->Bash, write_to_file->Write, replace_file_content->Edit...; geminiMap: run_shell_command->Bash, write_file->Write...); sets $isGeminiFam = (the agy 'tool' field exists) OR (the tool needed mapping); logs a usage proxy to ~/.gemini/wkgemini_usage.jsonl; pipes the adapted JSON to wkappbot-kih/tools/wkharness.ps1; captures $kihExit. wkharness-post.ps1 is the parallel AfterTool relay.
